title: The Superbrain Must Learn, Verify, and Compound

source.path: Naya Power Smart Notes architecture discussion

summary: Naya Power should give people a living superbrain that remembers what matters, proves when knowledge was saved, reports what they learned each day, and compounds that learning forever.
what_happened: We clarified that the real magic is not having lots of notes. It is having a system that captures the meaningful things from a day, verifies that they were made, reports back what was learned and how the person grew, and then compounds those reports over longer periods.
what_we_learned: Time should be the primary way memory is organized, while meaning makes it searchable.
Naya and Shawn notes about one event should be connected, not scattered into unrelated piles.
Every Smart Note should come with a receipt so the person can see that it was actually made and verified.
The Daily Intelligence Report is a powerful daily reward: What happened? What did I learn? How did I grow? What were the wins? What needs attention? What is next?
Daily reports can compound into weekly, monthly, quarterly, six-month, annual, and lifetime intelligence.
People can use the same system for projects, learning goals, aha moments, assessment scores, and personal growth.
why_it_matters: This makes Naya Power immediately useful every day while also creating a long-term intelligence asset that becomes more valuable as the person's history compounds.
what_changed: The Smart Notes architecture is now defined around shared Note Events.
Daily Intelligence Reports are established as the core CIS ritual.
Verification receipts are mandatory for Smart Notes and intelligence reports.
The architecture is documented so different AI instances can operate the same way.
next_best_action: Finish the runtime implementation for chronological event storage, verification receipts, feed receipts, and Daily Intelligence Report generation so the internal Naya Power system can experience the same magic it will eventually offer to users.
content: The product promise is simple: Naya helps you learn, remember, reflect, and grow every day. The superbrain should never make the human remember where something was filed. It should remember how to find it.

evidence: File was created in the canonical repository and fetched successfully afterward.
The event_id, timestamp, representation, required Smart Note fields, canonical URL, and time bucket are present.
INDEX.json contains this note and maps it to the shared event.
